subject.title: [Bug]: Agent repeats identical replies 2-10x on Telegram after 5.20 update

question: Should OpenClaw establish a single shared delivery-state contract that collapses preview/final replay and prevents delivery-mirror records from becoming visible sends, or continue fixing each channel-specific replay path independently?
rationale: The remaining reports describe overlapping but not proven-identical mechanisms, and the correct collapse point determines whether final text, media, and transcript records remain deliverable.

options.title: Adopt a shared delivery contract
options.body: Define visibility and idempotency semantics once in the auto-reply delivery layer, then prove Telegram, WebChat, and WhatsApp do not replay streamed content.

options.title: Keep channel-scoped repairs
options.body: Continue targeted channel fixes, accepting that shared delivery and transcript paths may require separate future investigations.

recommendation.title: Adopt a shared delivery contract
recommendation.body: Define visibility and idempotency semantics once in the auto-reply delivery layer, then prove Telegram, WebChat, and WhatsApp do not replay streamed content.

likelyOwner.reason: Their current-main reproduction and merged Telegram replay repair give them the strongest supplied history signal for the delivery behavior.
